title: SystemLifecycle
description: Optional lifecycle hooks of a System, called by the registry that owns it. Each must be synchronous, like the phases. - onAttach inside SystemRegistry.add, before the system takes part in any phase - also when the add is buffered until the frame boundary. - onEnable once the system is registered and its owner can run it: at once for `app.systems`, and while the scene is active for `scene.systems`. Pausing the scene does not disable its systems. - onDisable when that stops: the system is removed, the scene is retained, or its teardown begins. - onDetach when the registry lets go of the system: at the frame boundary after a removal during a frame, at once otherwise, and when the registry is destroyed - in which case `destroy()` follows. A throwing `onAttach` cancels the registration and propagates out of `add()`. A throwing `onEnable` is reported and followed by `onDisable`, so the system can release what it acquired before the throw; it stays registered but its phases do not run. Failures of the other hooks are reported and never stop the teardown they belong to.

members.name: onAttach
members.description: Called when the system is added, with the registry's context.

members.name: onDetach
members.description: Called when the registry lets go of the system. The context is no longer valid afterwards.

members.name: onDisable
members.description: Called when the system stops taking part in the frame.

members.name: onEnable
members.description: Called when the system starts taking part in the frame. Release in onDisable what this acquires.
